name: Qi Tuning
description: Tune an ally's flow of qi to the pitch of the user's soul so their casting runs smoother.

name: Flow Listening
description: Listen to the rise and fall of an ally's qi through the soul and mark where it stalls.

name: Tuned Screen
description: Tune a screen of qi to the user's soul note so that a hostile blow rings off it dully.

name: Qi Chorus
description: Sound a chorus through the qi of several allies so that their techniques gain a shared depth.

name: Knot Unsnarling
description: Sing out a knot in an ally's qi circulation until the stalled flow runs free again.

name: Pulse Mending
description: Ring the soul in time with a failing pulse and draw qi and soul together to mend the ally.

name: Doubled Cast
description: Echo an ally's qi technique a beat later with a soul note so it strikes in both layers.

name: Borne Surge
description: Carry the qi of an ally on a surge of soul tone so that every technique runs at its peak.

name: Heartbeat Recall
description: Ring the soul to the beat of a stopped heart and draw its qi flowing again within the short window.

name: Imprinted Swell
description: Imprint the user's soul tone upon the qi of the whole company and swell it to a great height.

name: Soulborne Qi
description: streams: Resonate Soul + Qi; ring the soul through an ally's qi so that each technique they cast carries a soul note and lands with doubled force.

name: Marrow Hum
description: Hum a note down to the marrow of a partner so that their body answers with steadier strength.

name: Bone Listening
description: Listen through a partner's bones with the soul to find any crack or strain in their frame.

name: Sounding Frame
description: Set the whole frame of the user ringing so that a blow spends itself in the sound.

name: Sinew Mending
description: Sing a slow note along torn sinew until the fibres draw together and the strain eases.

name: Body Chorus
description: Raise a chorus in the bodies of several partners so that their strength swells in one beat.

name: Fibre Rinse
description: Rinse the fibres of a partner's body with clean tone until poison and taint run out of them.

name: Frame Resonance
description: Set a partner's body ringing after a blow so that the second strike carries the first one's weight.

name: Pulse Rouse
description: Beat the soul in time with a partner's pulse and quicken it into a strong and even drive.

name: Resonant Frame
description: Make the whole body of a partner a resonant frame that carries and strengthens every blow.

name: Bonesong Recall
description: Sing the song of the bones over a fallen partner and call body and soul back in the short window.

name: Shuddering Chord
description: Strike a chord that shudders through the bodies of foes and loosens their stance and their soul hold.

name: Marrow Octave
description: Lift the note in a partner's marrow an octave so that body and soul work at the top of their pitch.

name: Voiced Body
description: streams: Resonate Soul + Body; sound the soul through a partner's whole frame so that muscle bone and breath move as one instrument at full strength.

name: Singing Flesh
description: streams: Resonate Soul + Body; ring a healing chord through the flesh of an ally so that wounds close in time with the sound.
